title: Exhaustive frontier survey and problem discovery
question: What unresolved scientific questions can this exact longitudinal MJ NAFLD dataset answer unusually well, after accounting for existing NAFLD/MASLD, dynamic prediction, trajectory, pollution, and causal literature?
acceptance_criteria: Structured extraction for closest and field-defining papers
Question × data-structure saturation map with reverse-search falsification
Top 3 directions ranked by scientific and feasibility criteria
Deep-learning-free answer to the most interesting scientific question
completion_note: Milestone reached: broad survey is sufficient to transition from literature expansion to data audit. Surviving directions are history decomposition, observation/detection process, pre-detection trajectories, environmental reversibility, and causal identifiability; temporal generalization is a validation axis.
